fields.value: Additional file 15: of Surface PEGylation suppresses pulmonary effects of CuO in allergen-induced lung inflammation

dsDescriptionValue.value: Figure S11. DEGs with a positive fold change in OVA-challenged mice exposed to 40 μg of CuO PEG versus core CuO at the same dose belong to processes related to inflammatory response. Treemap of GO biological processes significantly enriched by up-regulated genes in OVA-challenged mice exposed to 40 μg of CuO PEG compared against core CuO at the same dose. The size of each rectangle reflects FDR of the corresponding GO term. GO terms are grouped by semantic similarity (SimRel, similarity = 0.5) into the same upper hierarchy term, visualized with different colours. (TIF 732 kb)
